```yaml
name: Check Release

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true
      - name: Install zizmor
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y zizmor
      - name: Lint with zizmor
        run: zizmor --format plain .

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true
      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --all

  test-all-features:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true
      - name: Run tests with all features
        run: cargo test --all-features

  docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true
      - name: Build documentation
        run: cargo doc --all --document-private-items

  coverage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true
      - name: Generate coverage report
        run: cargo tarpaulin --out Xml

  conformance:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true
      - name: Run conformance checks
        run: cargo run --bin conformance

  nix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Nix
        uses: cachix/install-nix-action@v18
        with:
          nix-channel: https://nixos.org/channels/nixpkgs-unstable
      - name: Build with Nix
        run: nix-build

  check-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true
      - name: Run release checks
        run: cargo run --bin release-checks

  release:
    needs: [lint, test, test-all-features, docs, coverage, conformance, nix, check-release]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true
      - name: Publish release
        uses: facebook/dotslash-publish-release@v2
        with:
          config: path/to/release/config.json
          tag: ${{ github.ref_name }}

  zizmor:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true
      - name: Run zizmor
        run: zizmor --format plain .
```
